# iximiuz-labs_playground (Resource)

Manages an iximiuz Labs playground definition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iximiuz-labs_playground" "example" {
  name_prefix = "my-playground"
  base        = "docker"
  title       = "My Playground"
  description = "A custom playground for Docker experimentation"

  categories = ["linux"]

  tab {
    kind    = "terminal"
    name    = "Terminal"
    machine = "docker-01"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `name_prefix` (String) A name prefix for the playground. The API will append a unique suffix to produce the final `name`.

- `tab` (Block List) Tab definitions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--tab))

- `published` (Boolean) Whether the playground is publicly listed.
